desc: The firearm is also equipped with front and back wide-angled slide serrations, tactical rail and the new G10 grip making this the ultimate Tactical 1911. The new TAC series comes in two configurations, the single-stack model, which comes in 45 ACP and 10mm, and the high-capacity model, which comes in .45 or 9mm. Both have a full dust cover rail to even the weight and reduce recoil. Upgrades included are ambidextrous safety, combat hammer, and extended beavertail for maximum comfort and safety.
